feature_contract.goal: Connect actual game-authored D3D9 programmable pixel shader alpha compare state and live ALPHAREF into a compiled native D3D11 SM3 game Draw so alpha-tested menu, car selection and race geometry can render with DX9Ex fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Live D3D9 ALPHATESTENABLE and ALPHAFUNC cause native HLSL pixel discard after real ps_3_0 output for supported compares, rather than rejecting every alpha-tested game draw.

Bound integer ALPHAREF is uploaded to independent D3D11 PS b1 per draw; supported comparison modes use separately cached shaders; malformed or unsafe state keeps original D3D9/DX9Ex game render/input/FFB.

Actual native VS/PS/DrawIndexed source, portable alpha truth-table probe and live-draw static regression exist; all mandatory exact-SHA Fast/Backend/Build/OpenXR/HUD gates must pass before build-verified state.

integration_path: Capture actual game D3D9 programmable draw ALPHATESTENABLE, ALPHAFUNC and ALPHAREF without altering the original gameplay draw
Compile SM3 pixel output with comparison-specific HLSL discard and exact pipeline cache identity
Upload live ALPHAREF into D3D11 PS constant buffer slot b1 and submit native Draw/DrawIndexed while protecting original D3D9 input/FFB fallback

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: SM3 pixel HLSL alpha compare and source-bound PS b1 upload implemented; final exact-SHA CI outstanding.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Reject unsupported alpha modes/references and disallow cache variant reuse; DX9Ex game render/input/FFB fallback unchanged.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 source alpha render states -> native HLSL SM3 shader compiler and comparison-specific pipeline cache -> live D3D11 PS b1 constant + GPU Draw/DrawIndexed.

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native game draw stays opt-in and fail closed; original D3D9/DX9Ex renderer/input/FFB authoritative, DXVK frozen.
